messages:
incident-bot: [P1] alert: policy-evaluator (smart-routing) crashed in eu-west-1. error rate spiking -> 502/504 from routing service. paging on-call.

matt_oncall: saw it — getting paged now. mounting dashboard.

sara_engineer: I can see a repeated fallback loop: requests hit policy-eval, it returns error, router falls back to region routing policy which triggers policy-eval again. loop.

elliot_sre: can you grab recent logs from the policy pod? `kubectl logs -n infra policy-eval-78f9`

sara_engineer: tail pasted below (last 30s):
```
2026-03-12T14:12:03Z ERROR policy-eval runtime panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
2026-03-12T14:12:03Z ERROR stack: goroutine 142 [running]:
main.evaluateRule(0xc0002f5f00, 0x0)
	/go/src/redwood/inference/policy/eval.go:214 +0x2d4
main.Evaluate(0xc0002f5f00)
	/go/src/redwood/inference/policy/eval.go:98 +0x85
rpc.(*Server).HandleEval(0xc000120000, 0xc000158000, 0xc00016a000)
	/go/src/redwood/inference/rpc/server.go:312 +0x1a3
```

matt_oncall: that nil deref points to rule evaluation touching a missing attribute. did we push a policy change recently?

sara_engineer: yes — there was a ruleset update ~14:10 that added `request.customer.region_preference` to a routing expression. telemetry shows many requests don't include that field. expression evaluator assumes it exists. code should handle absent attrs but it panics.

elliot_sre: immediate mitigation options: 1) disable smart-routing policy evaluation globally; 2) rollback policy config to previous snapshot; 3) deploy emergency safe-check hotfix to evaluator to treat missing attrs as null rather than panic.

blake_ops: disabling smart-routing will route by default region mapping (slightly higher latency but much safer). I can flip the feature flag in Console -> Routing -> smart-routing.enabled = false.

matt_oncall: do that. call it out to customers. Sara/elliot, take ownership of rollback/hotfix. I'll coordinate comms.

sara_engineer: running rollback command: `redwoodctl policy rollback --env=prod --policy=smart-routing --to=2026-03-12T13:58:00Z`

sara_engineer: rollback confirmed, controllers picked up new config.

elliot_sre: I'm patching the evaluator to guard attribute access and return evaluation=false instead of panicking. building image now (`gcr.io/redwood/policy-eval:hotfix-1772`).

incident-bot: action taken: policy rollback applied by sara_engineer at 2026-03-12T14:18:22Z. On-call matt_oncall assigned.

kim_cs: Kim from CS — customers reporting 5xxs for EU orgs, can you give ETA for full recovery? I need to send to affected accounts.

matt_oncall: baseline: rollback should stop the panic immediately once controllers propagate (1-2 min). Full routing normalization ~5-10 min. I'm drafting a short customer note.

blake_ops: metrics show error rate dropping already (eu-west-1 5xx from 28% -> 7% in last 2 min). latency back to baseline for routed traffic.

sara_engineer: hotfix image built and pushed. planning canary replace of policy-eval deployment in eu-west-1 only: `kubectl set image deployment/policy-eval policy-eval=gcr.io/redwood/policy-eval:hotfix-1772 -n infra`

elliot_sre: starting canary rollout now (1 pod). watch logs for panic regressions.

sara_engineer: canary pod logs clean so far, evaluator returns errors instead of panicking for missing attrs. sample log: `WARN policy-eval missing attribute request.customer.region_preference, treating as null`

matt_oncall: good. if canary looks stable for 3m, we do full replace.

incident-bot: timeline update: 14:15 alert triggered; 14:18 rollback applied; 14:23 canary started; 14:27 errors decreased below threshold; 14:31 canary healthy -> proceeding full rollout.

blake_ops: full rollout started (eu-west-1 -> eu-central -> us-west-2 staged).

kim_cs: sending update to impacted customers now: short note with cause and mitigation, cc'ing account teams.

matt_oncall: next: postmortem owners? sara_engineer + elliot_sre are owners. please include root cause (policy change introduced non-nullable attr), mitigation plan (validation & CI for policy expressions), and follow-ups (safe evaluator, automated policy linting).

sara_engineer: immediate follow-ups I propose:
- Add schema validation step to policy deploy pipeline to reject expressions referencing non-existing attributes.
- Add unit test coverage for evaluator guarding absent fields.
- Add a runtime feature flag to enable conservative evaluation mode.
- Backfill missing telemetry: track attr presence rates per customer.

elliot_sre: I'll add alerting to detect sustained evaluation failures (>=5% eval errors over 1m) and auto-disable smart-routing if panic-like patterns appear.

matt_oncall: I'll handoff to elliot in 20m for on-call. elliot, keep monitoring for 1h and ramp down alert noise.

elliot_sre: ack. leaving Slack thread open and will post when incident is declared resolved.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> customers routed normally. Next step: postmortem draft by 2026-03-14.

kim_cs: thanks team — sharing update with affected accounts. please ping me if new impact appears. :pray:
